//data_dir: Where exports land. ~ is expanded. Point it into iCloud Drive or OneDrive to see the CSVs on your iPhone, e.g. C:/Users/you/iCloudDrive/OuraData
//headless: true = no browser window during scheduled runs.
//code_source: How the job gets Oura's emailed sign-in code: 'gmail' reads it over IMAP with an app password (unattended); 'prompt' means a person types it.
//imap_user: Blank means the same address as email.
//min_hours_between_requests: Request a new export at most this often (22 so a 3-hourly schedule doesn't drift later each day).
//wait_minutes: After requesting, wait this long in the same run; otherwise a later run collects it.
//max_logins_per_day: Unattended sign-in attempts allowed per 24 h, so a problem can't flood your inbox or lock the account.
